simulation_reference.motion_transfer: Carrier-relative left-side fixed-finger contact; height-first upper poses aim at grasp orientation; XY converges during descent; high hold 3 s; reverse path to original seat, release, withdraw. Physical torque is not set. Return placement has not been tested in contact simulation.
simulation_reference.note: Z and heading are simulation installation candidates. Verify actual rim height, docking direction, camera extrinsics and TCP. Mass/friction do not change motor commands.
